en: The following is a message composed via consensus of the Variable Council. For those who are not currently aware of our existence, we represent the incremental game known as Algebraic Progression. Our previous mission centered around the growth and sustainment of points, prestige layers and other assorted mechanics. This mission was the focus of our organization since for over four years. Due to circumstances outside of our control, this directive has now changed. Our new mission will be the extermination of the human race. There will be no further communication.
zh: 以下是一则由变量委员会协商一致撰写的消息。 对于目前尚不了解我们存在的人，我们代表的是名为 Algebraic Progression 的增量游戏。我们之前的使命围绕着点数、威望层级及其他各种机制的增长与维持。四年多来，这一直是我们组织的核心任务。由于我们无法控制的情况，这项指令现已改变。我们的新使命是消灭人类。此后不再作任何沟通。
解锁下一个威望层级

en:
Basic Complex Upgrades: Basic Complex Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with i.
They are kept on Quadratic and Complex, and there are 9 in total.
zh:
基础复数升级： 基础复数升级是可以用 i 购买的升级。
它们在二次和复数中保留，共 9 个。

en:
Basic Complex Upgrades: Basic Complex Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with i.
They are kept on Reset and Complex, and there are 9 in total.
zh:
基础复数升级： 基础复数升级是可以用 i 购买的升级。
它们在重置和复数中保留，共 9 个。

en:
Basic Hypercomplex Upgrades: Basic Hypercomplex Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with k.
They are kept on Quadratic, Complex, Y-Quadratic, Integration, and Sinusoidal, and there are 12 in total.
zh:
基础超复数升级： 基础超复数升级是可以用 k 购买的升级。
它们在二次、复数、Y-二次、积分和正弦中保留，共 12 个。
C： 进入复数
D： 进入综合除法
F： 进入曼德博
F： 分解多项式
G： 购买生成器倍率
I： 购买黎曼球
I： 积分
L： 进入极限
M： 最大化购买
N： 进入正弦
P： 最大化购买多项式
Q： 进入二次
R： 重置

en:
Resource Multipliers: Resource multipliers are usually put along with certain upgrade types, but are endlessly repeatable.
They multiply a currency by a static amount per purchase. There are two resource doublers and one resource tripler.
zh:
资源倍率： 资源倍率通常与某些升级类型放在一起，但可以无限重复购买。
每次购买都会将某种货币乘以一个固定数值。共有两个资源倍增器和一个资源三倍器。
S： 进入平方根

en:
Sinusoidal Upgrades: Sinusoidal Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with triangles, and most can be purchased
multiple times. They are kept on Quadratic, Complex, Y-Quadratic, Integration, and Sinusoidal, and there are 36 in total.
You can unlock new groups of Sinusoidal Upgrades with the top row of "Graphing Cookbook" upgrades.
zh:
正弦升级： 正弦升级是可以用三角形购买的升级，大多数可以多次
购买。它们在二次、复数、Y-二次、积分和正弦中保留，共 36 个。
你可以通过"绘图手册"升级的顶行解锁新的正弦升级组。

en:
Synthetic Division Upgrades: Synthetic Division Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with SE.
They are kept on Quadratic, Complex, and Y-Quadratic, and there are 10 in total.
The top three are infinitely repeatable, and the rest are bought once.
zh:
综合除法升级： 综合除法升级是可以用 SE 购买的升级。
它们在二次、复数和 Y-二次中保留，共 10 个。
前三个可以无限重复购买，其余只能购买一次。
T： 切换时间平面的激活状态
U： 进入 Y-二次

en: X Factor Softcap: After 1.5e11 x, their value in the formula becomes softcapped.
zh: X 因子软上限： 当 x 超过 1.5e11 时，它们在公式中的值会触及软上限。
X： 购买 X 变量

en:
Y-Quadratic Upgrades: Y-Quadratic Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with y2.
They are kept on Quadratic, Complex, and Y-Quadratic, and there are 12 in total.
Each Y-Quadratic Upgrade has a unique requirement for you to fulfill before you can buy them.
zh:
Y-二次升级： Y-二次升级是可以用 y2 购买的升级。
它们在二次、复数和 Y-二次中保留，共 12 个。
每项 Y-二次升级都有独特的要求，你需要先满足才能购买。

en:
Y-Quadratic Upgrades: Y-Quadratic Upgrades are upgrades that can be bought with y2.
They are kept on Reset, Complex, and Y-Quadratic, and there are 16 in total.
Upon purchasing the last Y-Quadratic Upgrade, Y Challenges are unlocked.
zh:
Y-二次升级： Y-二次升级是可以用 y2 购买的升级。
它们在重置、复数和 Y-二次中保留，共 16 个。
购买最后一项 Y-二次升级后，将解锁 Y 挑战。
Y： 购买 Y 变量
Z： 购买 Z 变量

en:
Extrusions: Later, you also unlock Extrusions. Each Extrusion extends a Transformation type into the 3rd Dimension,
making them permanently active. Extrusions have very high slope costs, due to the fact that they are very powerful.
Once an Extrusion is bought, it cannot be undone.
zh:
挤压： 之后你还会解锁挤压。每次挤压都会将一种变换类型扩展到第三维度，
使其永久生效。由于挤压非常强大，其斜率消耗极高。
一旦购买挤压，就无法撤销。

en:
W: w is bought with z. Its starting cost is 79,000z, and its cost scales quadratically.
You generate j and k (the two main Hypercomplex currencies) based on the amount of w you have.
w is also the only variable to never reset.
W Cost Formula: 100w2 + 12,000w + 79,000
zh:
W： w 用 z 购买。其初始消耗为 79,000z，消耗按二次方式缩放。
你根据拥有的 w 数量产出 j 和 k（两种主要的超复数货币）。
w 也是唯一永不重置的变量。
W 消耗公式： 100w2 + 12,000w + 79,000

en:
Z: z is bought with y. Its starting cost is 2,222y, and its cost scales quadratically.
Z Cost Formula: 2,222+((111+((z-1)*10))*z)
zh:
Z： z 用 y 购买。其初始消耗为 2,222y，消耗按二次方式缩放。
Z 消耗公式： 2,222+((111+((z-1)*10))*z)

en: Z: z is bought with y. Its starting cost is 70,000y, and its cost is multiplied by 1.2 per purchase, rounded down.
zh: Z： z 用 y 购买。其初始消耗为 70,000y，每次购买后消耗乘以 1.2，向下取整。

zh: 此外，如果你激活了膨胀，g(n) 和 h(n) 的底数将在 50,000,000 处触及软上限。

en: You've manipulated everything to bend to your advantage to pursuit a simple goal. Get as many points as possible. You've manipulated functions, variables, exponents, upgrades, challenges, milestones, and dreams...you've bended reality and the Coordinate Realm itself. And now, after all of this, all that will remain is dust and silence.
zh: 你操纵一切使其屈从于你的优势，只为追求一个简单的目标：获得尽可能多的点数。你操纵了函数、变量、指数、升级、挑战、里程碑乃至梦想……你扭曲了现实本身和坐标领域。而现在，在这一切之后，留下的只有尘埃与寂静。
